correctness.rationale: The full centralizer normal form B=[[P,Y],[0,P]] follows from explicit block multiplication. B is square zero exactly when P²=0 and PY+YP=0. A rank-k square-zero P has image U and kernel K with U contained in K; after a decomposition U⊕H⊕T, the anticommutator equation leaves a free s×s quotient block Q and q^{2k(r-k)} other parameters, where s=r-2k. The complete block-map rank is exactly rank B=2k+rank Q. Counting P by image, kernel, isomorphism and counting rank-Q matrices yields the formula. Degree analysis proves the asymptotic law; no step divides by 2. A standalone direct checker confirms every stratum for (q,r)=(2,1),(2,2),(3,2),(4,2),(2,3), including nonprime q=4; finite checks are not the proof.

originality.rationale: The full joint distribution of (rank(B),rank(AB)) for a fixed square-zero A of rank half the ambient dimension is not supplied by the closely applicable 2007 existence/rank theorem, by the 2026 Jordan-type survey, or by the 2024 attainable-orbit classification. Standard block centralizers and Gaussian coefficients are not asserted to be new; the exact two-rank frequency and the resulting field-size uniformity are. Searches under product-rank, square-zero, dual-number, nilpotent-commutator, and finite-field aliases found no covering formula. A differently phrased older enumeration remains a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: Equivalently formulated finite-field counts in older representation-theoretic or Hall-polynomial literature could exist.

value.rationale: Joint rank of B and AB is a natural two-operator invariant not determined by individual Jordan types. The exact finite-field law refines the classical factorization rank constraint in every even dimension. Equal leading degrees and coefficients for all product-rank strata yield a nonobvious asymptotic uniformity phenomenon while almost all admissible B have maximal possible square-zero rank. This is a structural infinite-family census rather than an arbitrary low-dimensional table or cosmetic restatement.
